mechanism: Target weekday gaps in existing interregional routes
what_changes: Shift one weekly departure day/time on an existing RW city pair to a competitor-thin weekday without adding aircraft-hours
measurement: Directed bookings and net contribution by weekday before/after plus donor-route contribution
threshold_or_missing_fact: Run only if incremental contribution exceeds displaced donor contribution and operating cost; requires RW booking curves and airport slots

mechanism: Replace weak frequency with a paired interregional rotation
what_changes: Substitute a low-contribution rotation from an existing route for a direct pair while preserving weekly aircraft budget
measurement: Network contribution delta including cannibalisation and donor loss
threshold_or_missing_fact: Proceed only if delta vs KEEP > 0 in conservative case; demand and cost inputs UNKNOWN

mechanism: Season-split a route rather than year-round commitment
what_changes: Concentrate available days in published seasonal demand/competition windows and return aircraft to KEEP off-season
measurement: Monthly directed contribution and fixed/variable cost avoided
threshold_or_missing_fact: Requires monthly RW OD sales and competitor calendars; no winter snapshot extrapolation to H2 2027

mechanism: Alter departure time on existing RW nonstop
what_changes: Move departure into a useful business/leisure bank while holding frequency/aircraft constant
measurement: Directional bookings by departure-time band and net contribution
threshold_or_missing_fact: Only if shifted time outperforms current time net of missed connections/crew duty and airport constraints; UNKNOWN

mechanism: Strengthen an existing direct route on high-yield days
what_changes: Move one rotation from low-yield weekday to observed high-yield weekday rather than add a new pair
measurement: Weekday fare mix and contribution per rotation
threshold_or_missing_fact: Requires route-day fares and bookings; price/frequency asymmetry is not LF evidence
